_comment: Lutin's Hollow own art (make_hollow_art.py): piece -> sheet cell [x, y] and size w x h in 16 px cells; overlays, magenta = clear; doors and passable are cells within the piece; empty = cells with nothing drawn.

hollow_tree.comment: The Pokemon Center: a vast hollow live oak, arched lit door under a red hood, Poke Ball plaque (7x6).

gym_arbour.comment: Lutin's gym: a glade pavilion behind curtains of Spanish moss, parted at the glowing door (7x5).

herbalist.comment: The Herbalist (shop): the cottages' roof and walls, a blue sign, herbs drying all along the eave, a crate of cuttings (6x4).

cottage_a.comment: Moss cottage A: cushioned moss roof, round plank door, round lit windows, herbs under the eave, chimney east (5x4).

cottage_b.comment: Moss cottage B: green round door, chimney west, a climbing rose, toadstools in the roof moss (5x4).

fairy_ring.comment: A fairy ring of pale toadstools on darker grass (3x3, all walkable).

tree_a.comment: Ring tree A: a moss-hung live oak, round crown (3x3, blocking; opaque crown).

tree_b.comment: Ring tree B: broad two-humped crown (3x3, blocking; lower half = tree_a's tiles).

tree_c.comment: Ring tree C: tall crown in pink bloom (3x3, blocking; lower half = tree_a's tiles).

pepper_bed.comment: A raised bed of red peppers (3x2, blocking); tiles east-west (half posts at the ends).

pool.comment: A still reflecting pool in a ring of mossy stones (2x2, blocking).

tree_s.comment: Small ring tree: a young moss-hung oak (2x2, blocking).

riddle_stone.comment: The riddle stone: a mossy standing stone, a glowing carved flame-tail (1x2, blocking).

mossy_log.comment: Fallen log furred with moss, toadstools, bracket fungus (2x1, blocking).

bloom_gold.comment: A drift of gold wildflowers (1x1, walkable).

bloom_pink.comment: A drift of pink wildflowers (1x1, walkable).

bloom_violet.comment: A drift of violet wildflowers (1x1, walkable).

bloom_white.comment: A drift of white wildflowers (1x1, walkable).

bush_a.comment: Understory shrub in white blossom (1x1, blocking).

bush_b.comment: Yaupon shrub with red berries (1x1, blocking).

fern_a.comment: A clump of arching ferns (1x1, walkable).

fern_b.comment: A clump of arching ferns (1x1, walkable).

fern_c.comment: A clump of arching ferns (1x1, walkable).

glowbell.comment: Glow-bells: pale cyan bells lit from within (1x1, walkable).

moss_mound.comment: A low cushion of moss and a fern sprig (1x1, walkable).

thicket_a.comment: Thicket: dense dark leaves for the cracks between trunks (1x1, blocking).

toadstool_red.comment: Red toadstools with white spots (1x1, walkable).
